115	def _is_int(value: object) -> bool:
116	    """JSON booleans are ints in Python; checkpoints treat them as wrong."""
117	    return isinstance(value, int) and not isinstance(value, bool)
118	
119	
120	def _as_cell(value: object, description: str) -> Position:
121	    """Validate a user supplied coordinate as a two-integer pair."""
122	    if isinstance(value, (str, bytes)) or not isinstance(value, (tuple, list)):
123	        raise ValueError(f"{description} must be a [x, y] integer pair")
124	    if len(value) != 2:
125	        raise ValueError(f"{description} must be a [x, y] integer pair")
126	    if not all(_is_int(coord) for coord in value):
127	        raise ValueError(f"{description} coordinates must be integers, not booleans or other types")
128	    return value[0], value[1]
129	
130	
131	def _as_pair(value: object, description: str) -> tuple[int, int]:
132	    if (
133	        not isinstance(value, list)
134	        or len(value) != 2
135	        or not all(_is_int(coord) for coord in value)
136	    ):
137	        raise ValueError(f"{description} must be a [x, y] integer pair")
138	    return value[0], value[1]

141	class FleetSimulator:
142	    def __init__(self, grid: GridMap, robots: list[Robot], tasks: list[Task]) -> None:
143	        self.grid = grid
144	        # The map as built before any runtime edit; map-change history is
145	        # replayed against this baseline.
146	        self.base_grid = grid
147	        self.robots = {robot.robot_id: robot for robot in robots}
148	        self.tasks = {task.task_id: task for task in tasks}
149	        self.tick = 0
150	        self.replay: list[dict[str, object]] = []
151	        self.map_changes: list[dict[str, object]] = []
152	        self._map_sequence = 0
153	        self.paused_tasks: set[str] = set()
154	        # Consecutive per-robot waits caused purely by other robots:
155	        # robot_id -> {"blocked_by": [robot_id, ...], "ticks": int}.
156	        self._traffic_waits: dict[str, dict[str, object]] = {}
157	        positions = [robot.position for robot in robots]
158	        if len(positions) != len(set(positions)):
159	            raise ValueError("robots cannot share an initial position")
160	        if any(not grid.traversable(position) for position in positions):
161	            raise ValueError("robot starts outside traversable map space")
162	
163	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
164	    # Dynamic map edits
165	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
166	
167	    def modify_obstacles(
168	        self,
169	        added: Sequence[Position] = (),
170	        removed: Sequence[Position] = (),
171	    ) -> dict[str, object]:
172	        """Close and/or reopen cells without advancing the simulation.
173	
174	        The whole request is validated before anything changes: coordinates
175	        must be two plain integers (booleans are rejected), lie inside the
176	        map, no cell may appear in both lists, and newly added obstacles may
177	        not cover a robot's current cell. Duplicate coordinates inside one
178	        batch are processed once. Adding an existing obstacle or removing a
179	        traversable cell is a no-op. Invalid requests raise :class:`ValueError`
180	        and leave every part of the state untouched.
181	
182	        Assigned unfinished tasks keep their robot: routes are replanned
183	        against the new map, or, when a required point is unreachable, cleared
184	        while the task is suspended. No tick is recorded, no robot moves and no
185	        distance is accumulated.
186	        """
187	        add_cells = self._normalize_cells(added, "added")
188	        remove_cells = self._normalize_cells(removed, "removed")
189	        conflict = set(add_cells) & set(remove_cells)
190	        if conflict:
191	            cell = sorted(conflict)[0]
192	            raise ValueError(
193	                f"cell {list(cell)} is both added and removed in the same request"
194	            )
195	        occupied = {robot.position for robot in self.robots.values()}
196	        for cell in add_cells:
197	            if cell in occupied:
198	                raise ValueError(
199	                    f"cannot add obstacle at {list(cell)}: a robot currently occupies it"
200	                )
201	        return self._apply_map_change(add_cells, remove_cells)
202	
203	    def _normalize_cells(self, cells: Sequence[Position], label: str) -> list[Position]:
204	        if isinstance(cells, (str, bytes)) or not isinstance(cells, (list, tuple)):
205	            raise ValueError(f"{label} cells must be provided as a list of [x, y] pairs")
206	        seen: set[Position] = set()
207	        ordered: list[Position] = []
208	        for index, cell in enumerate(cells):
209	            position = _as_cell(cell, f"{label} cell {index}")
210	            if not self.grid.contains(position):
211	                raise ValueError(f"{label} cell {list(position)} lies outside the map")
212	            if position in seen:
213	                # Batch-internal duplicates are handled once, not rejected.
214	                continue
215	            seen.add(position)
216	            ordered.append(position)
217	        return ordered
218	
219	    def _apply_map_change(
220	        self, added: list[Position], removed: list[Position]
221	    ) -> dict[str, object]:
222	        obstacles = set(self.grid.obstacles)
223	        actual_added = [cell for cell in added if cell not in obstacles]
224	        obstacles.update(actual_added)
225	        actual_removed = [cell for cell in removed if cell in obstacles]
226	        obstacles.difference_update(actual_removed)
227	        if not actual_added and not actual_removed:
228	            return self._map_change_record(self._map_sequence, [], [])
229	
230	        # Everything below only runs once the batch was fully validated and is
231	        # known to change the map.
232	        self.grid = GridMap(self.grid.width, self.grid.height, frozenset(obstacles))
233	        self._map_sequence += 1
234	        record = self._map_change_record(self._map_sequence, actual_added, actual_removed)
235	        self.map_changes.append(copy.deepcopy(record))
236	        self.replay.append(copy.deepcopy(record))
237	        self._reroute_after_map_change()
238	        return copy.deepcopy(record)
239	
240	    def _map_change_record(
241	        self, sequence: int, added: list[Position], removed: list[Position]
242	    ) -> dict[str, object]:
243	        return {
244	            "type": "map_change",
245	            "tick": self.tick,
246	            "sequence": sequence,
247	            "added": [list(cell) for cell in added],
248	            "removed": [list(cell) for cell in removed],
249	        }
250	
251	    def _plan_route(
252	        self, robot: Robot, task: Task, start: Position | None = None
253	    ) -> list[Position] | None:
254	        """Shortest current->pickup->dropoff route, or None if unreachable.
255	
256	        *start* overrides the robot's current position, which is how sidestep
257	        candidates are evaluated without moving the robot first.
258	        """
259	        origin = robot.position if start is None else start
260	        try:
261	            if not task.picked_up:
262	                if origin == task.pickup:
263	                    to_pickup: list[Position] = []
264	                else:
265	                    to_pickup = shortest_path(self.grid, origin, task.pickup)
266	                to_dropoff = shortest_path(self.grid, task.pickup, task.dropoff)
267	            else:
268	                # Goods are already on board: a reclosed pickup cell must not
269	                # pull the robot back.
270	                to_pickup = []
271	                to_dropoff = shortest_path(self.grid, origin, task.dropoff)
272	        except ValueError:
273	            return None
274	        return to_pickup + to_dropoff
275	
276	    def _reroute_after_map_change(self) -> None:
277	        for task in self.tasks.values():
278	            if task.completed or task.assigned_robot is None:
279	                continue
280	            robot = self.robots[task.assigned_robot]
281	            if robot.task_id != task.task_id:
282	                continue
283	            route = self._plan_route(robot, task)
284	            if route is None:
285	                robot.route = []
286	                self.paused_tasks.add(task.task_id)
287	            else:
288	                # Only the route is refreshed here; pickup/delivery are
289	                # confirmed at step start (or were already recorded).
290	                robot.route = route
291	                self.paused_tasks.discard(task.task_id)
292	
293	    def _recover_paused_tasks(self) -> None:
294	        """Resume tasks suspended by map unreachability where possible."""
295	        for task_id in sorted(self.paused_tasks):
296	            task = self.tasks.get(task_id)
297	            if task is None or task.completed or task.assigned_robot is None:
298	                self.paused_tasks.discard(task_id)
299	                continue
300	            robot = self.robots[task.assigned_robot]
301	            if robot.task_id != task.task_id:
302	                self.paused_tasks.discard(task_id)
303	                continue
304	            route = self._plan_route(robot, task)
305	            if route is None:
306	                robot.route = []
307	                continue
308	            robot.route = route
309	            self.paused_tasks.discard(task_id)
310	            self._finish_if_arrived(robot)
311	
312	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
313	    # Traffic conflicts and yielding
314	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
315	
316	    def _route_cells(self, exclude_id: str) -> set[Position]:
317	        """Cells every robot except *exclude_id* still plans to drive through."""
318	        cells: set[Position] = set()
319	        for robot in self.robots.values():
320	            if robot.robot_id != exclude_id:
321	                cells.update(robot.route)
322	        return cells
323	
324	    def _idle_sidestep_cell(
325	        self,
326	        blocker: Robot,
327	        requester: Robot,
328	        occupied: dict[Position, str],
329	        reserved: dict[Position, str],
330	    ) -> Position | None:
331	        """Free side-cell an idle blocker can yield to, or None.
332	
333	        The target may not be the requester's own cell (that would swap the
334	        two robots within one tick) nor any cell another robot still plans to
335	        drive through, so the blocker never trades one blockage for another.
336	        """
337	        on_routes = self._route_cells(exclude_id=blocker.robot_id)
338	        for cell in self.grid.neighbors(blocker.position):
339	            if cell == requester.position:
340	                continue
341	            if cell in occupied or cell in reserved:
342	                continue
343	            if cell in on_routes:
344	                continue
345	            return cell
346	        return None
347	
348	    def _self_sidestep(
349	        self,
350	        robot: Robot,
351	        task: Task | None,
352	        occupied: dict[Position, str],
353	        reserved: dict[Position, str],
354	    ) -> tuple[Position, list[Position]] | None:
355	        """Best side cell plus replanned route for a blocked robot, or None.
356	
357	        Only cells off every other robot's planned route qualify, and only if
358	        the task remains reachable from there; stepping backwards along the
359	        corridor is never useful and would just oscillate. Candidates are
360	        ranked by replanned route length with the deterministic neighbor order
361	        (up, left, right, down) breaking ties.
362	        """
363	        if task is None or task.completed:
364	            return None
365	        on_routes = self._route_cells(exclude_id=robot.robot_id)
366	        best: tuple[int, int, Position, list[Position]] | None = None
367	        for index, cell in enumerate(self.grid.neighbors(robot.position)):
368	            if cell in occupied or cell in reserved or cell in on_routes:
369	                continue
370	            route = self._plan_route(robot, task, start=cell)
371	            if route is None:
372	                continue
373	            if best is None or (len(route), index) < (best[0], best[1]):
374	                best = (len(route), index, cell, route)
375	        if best is None:
376	            return None
377	        return best[2], best[3]
378	
379	    def _update_traffic_waits(self, blocked_by: dict[str, str]) -> None:
380	        """Accumulate consecutive waits; any other outcome resets the counter."""
381	        for robot_id in list(self._traffic_waits):
382	            if robot_id not in blocked_by:
383	                del self._traffic_waits[robot_id]
384	        for robot_id, blocker_id in blocked_by.items():
385	            entry = self._traffic_waits.get(robot_id)
386	            if entry is None:
387	                self._traffic_waits[robot_id] = {"blocked_by": [blocker_id], "ticks": 1}
388	            else:
389	                entry["blocked_by"] = [blocker_id]
390	                entry["ticks"] = int(entry["ticks"]) + 1
391	
392	    def _traffic_wait_report(self) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
393	        return [
394	            {
395	                "robot_id": robot_id,
396	                "blocked_by": list(entry["blocked_by"]),
397	                "ticks": entry["ticks"],
398	            }
399	            for robot_id, entry in sorted(self._traffic_waits.items())
400	        ]
401	
402	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
403	    # Normal execution
404	    # ------------------------------------------------------------------
405	
406	    def assign_tasks(self) -> None:
407	        """Assign pending tasks to the nearest idle robot using stable tie breaks."""
408	        pending = [task for task in self.tasks.values() if task.assigned_robot is None]
409	        for task in sorted(pending, key=lambda item: item.task_id):
410	            choices: list[tuple[int, str, list[tuple[int, int]]]] = []
411	            for robot in self.robots.values():
412	                if not robot.idle:
413	                    continue
414	                try:
415	                    route = shortest_path(self.grid, robot.position, task.pickup)
416	                    route += shortest_path(self.grid, task.pickup, task.dropoff)
417	                except ValueError:
418	                    continue
419	                choices.append((len(route), robot.robot_id, route))
420	            if not choices:
421	                # No robot can reach this task yet; it keeps waiting and does
422	                # not block assignment of other tasks.
423	                continue
424	            _, robot_id, route = min(choices)
425	            robot = self.robots[robot_id]
426	            robot.task_id = task.task_id
427	            robot.route = route
428	            task.assigned_robot = robot_id
429	
430	    def _confirm_pickups(self) -> None:
431	        """A robot starting a tick on its pickup point collects first."""
432	        for robot in self.robots.values():
433	            if robot.task_id is None:
434	                continue
435	            task = self.tasks[robot.task_id]
436	            if not task.completed and not task.picked_up and robot.position == task.pickup:
437	                task.picked_up = True
438	
439	    def step(self) -> dict[str, object]:
440	        self._confirm_pickups()
441	        self._recover_paused_tasks()
442	        self.assign_tasks()
443	        # A robot assigned while already standing on the pickup cell collects
444	        # immediately instead of driving off without the goods.
445	        self._confirm_pickups()
446	        occupied = {robot.position: robot.robot_id for robot in self.robots.values()}
447	        reserved: dict[tuple[int, int], str] = {}
448	        moved: list[str] = []
449	        moved_ids: set[str] = set()
450	        blocked_by: dict[str, str] = {}
451	
452	        def relocate(robot: Robot, destination: tuple[int, int]) -> None:
453	            del occupied[robot.position]
454	            robot.position = destination
455	            robot.distance_travelled += 1
456	            occupied[destination] = robot.robot_id
457	            reserved[destination] = robot.robot_id
458	            moved.append(robot.robot_id)
459	            moved_ids.add(robot.robot_id)
460	
461	        for robot in sorted(self.robots.values(), key=lambda item: item.robot_id):
462	            if robot.robot_id in moved_ids:
463	                # Already yielded this tick at another robot's request.
464	                continue
465	            task = self.tasks[robot.task_id] if robot.task_id is not None else None
466	            if task is not None and task.task_id in self.paused_tasks:
467	                # Paused by map unreachability: stays put, never yields.
468	                continue
469	            if not robot.route:
470	                self._finish_if_arrived(robot)
471	                continue
472	            destination = robot.route[0]
473	            if not self.grid.traversable(destination):
474	                # Defensive: routes are normally replanned on every map edit.
475	                if task is not None and not task.completed:
476	                    route = self._plan_route(robot, task)
477	                    if route is None:
478	                        robot.route = []
479	                        self.paused_tasks.add(task.task_id)
480	                    else:
481	                        robot.route = route
482	                continue
483	            blocker_id = occupied.get(destination)
484	            if blocker_id is None:
485	                blocker_id = reserved.get(destination)
486	            if blocker_id is None or blocker_id == robot.robot_id:
487	                relocate(robot, destination)
488	                robot.route.pop(0)
489	                self._finish_if_arrived(robot)
490	                continue
491	            # Another robot is in the way; this is distinct from a
492	            # map-unreachability pause and the task stays active.
493	            blocker = self.robots[blocker_id]
494	            if blocker_id not in moved_ids:
495	                if blocker.task_id is None:
496	                    # Idle blocker: ask it to yield onto a free side cell,
497	                    # then take over the cell it vacated.
498	                    side = self._idle_sidestep_cell(blocker, robot, occupied, reserved)
499	                    if side is not None:
500	                        relocate(blocker, side)
501	                        relocate(robot, destination)
502	                        robot.route.pop(0)
503	                        self._finish_if_arrived(robot)
504	                        continue
505	                elif blocker.route:
506	                    ahead = blocker.route[0]
507	                    if (
508	                        self.grid.traversable(ahead)
509	                        and ahead not in occupied
510	                        and ahead not in reserved
511	                    ):
512	                        # The blocker is expected to drive on within this
513	                        # tick, so waiting one tick is cheaper than detouring.
514	                        blocked_by[robot.robot_id] = blocker_id
515	                        continue
516	            # The blocker cannot or will not move this tick: try to sidestep
517	            # onto a free adjacent cell and replan from there.
518	            side = self._self_sidestep(robot, task, occupied, reserved)
519	            if side is not None:
520	                cell, route = side
521	                relocate(robot, cell)
522	                robot.route = route
523	                self._finish_if_arrived(robot)
524	                continue
525	            blocked_by[robot.robot_id] = blocker_id
526	        self._update_traffic_waits(blocked_by)
527	        self.tick += 1
528	        event: dict[str, object] = {
529	            "type": "tick",
530	            "tick": self.tick,
531	            "moved": moved,
532	            "robots": {robot_id: list(robot.position) for robot_id, robot in sorted(self.robots.items())},
533	            "completed": sorted(task.task_id for task in self.tasks.values() if task.completed),
534	        }
535	        self.replay.append(event)
536	        return event
537	
538	    def _finish_if_arrived(self, robot: Robot) -> None:
539	        if robot.task_id is None:
540	            return
541	        task = self.tasks[robot.task_id]
542	        if task.task_id in self.paused_tasks:
543	            return
544	        if robot.position == task.pickup:
545	            task.picked_up = True
546	        if task.picked_up and robot.position == task.dropoff and not robot.route:
547	            task.completed = True
548	            self.paused_tasks.discard(task.task_id)
549	            robot.task_id = None

552	        completed = sum(task.completed for task in self.tasks.values())
553	        return {
554	            "ticks": self.tick,
555	            "tasks_total": len(self.tasks),
556	            "tasks_completed": completed,
557	            "tasks_paused": sorted(self.paused_tasks),
558	            "completion_ratio": completed / len(self.tasks) if self.tasks else 1.0,
559	            "distance_total": sum(robot.distance_travelled for robot in self.robots.values()),
560	            "traffic_waits": self._traffic_wait_report(),
561	        }

591	    def save_checkpoint(self, path: str | os.PathLike[str]) -> None:
592	        """Write the simulator state to *path* without changing this instance.
593	
594	        The write is atomic: an existing destination keeps either its complete
595	        old contents or the complete new contents, and a brand-new destination
596	        is either fully created or left absent. Filesystem or permission errors
597	        raise :class:`OSError`.
598	        """
599	        document = {
600	            "version": CHECKPOINT_VERSION,
601	            "grid": {
602	                "width": self.grid.width,
603	                "height": self.grid.height,
604	                "obstacles": [list(cell) for cell in sorted(self.grid.obstacles)],
605	            },
606	            "base_grid": {
607	                "width": self.base_grid.width,
608	                "height": self.base_grid.height,
609	                "obstacles": [list(cell) for cell in sorted(self.base_grid.obstacles)],
610	            },
611	            "tick": self.tick,
612	            "robots": [
613	                {
614	                    "robot_id": robot.robot_id,
615	                    "position": list(robot.position),
616	                    "route": [list(cell) for cell in robot.route],
617	                    "task_id": robot.task_id,
618	                    "distance_travelled": robot.distance_travelled,
619	                }
620	                for robot in sorted(self.robots.values(), key=lambda item: item.robot_id)
621	            ],
622	            "tasks": [
623	                {
624	                    "task_id": task.task_id,
625	                    "pickup": list(task.pickup),
626	                    "dropoff": list(task.dropoff),
627	                    "assigned_robot": task.assigned_robot,
628	                    "picked_up": task.picked_up,
629	                    "completed": task.completed,
630	                }
631	                for task in sorted(self.tasks.values(), key=lambda item: item.task_id)
632	            ],
633	            "replay": copy.deepcopy(self.replay),
634	            "map_changes": copy.deepcopy(self.map_changes),
635	            "paused_tasks": sorted(self.paused_tasks),
636	            "traffic_waits": self._traffic_wait_report(),
637	        }
638	        payload = (json.dumps(document, ensure_ascii=False, sort_keys=True, indent=2) + "\n").encode("utf-8")
639	
640	        directory = os.path.dirname(os.path.abspath(os.fspath(path))) or os.curdir
641	        fd, tmp_name = tempfile.mkstemp(prefix=".checkpoint-", suffix=".tmp", dir=directory)
642	        try:
643	            handle = os.fdopen(fd, "wb")
644	            try:
645	                handle.write(payload)
646	                handle.flush()
647	                os.fsync(handle.fileno())
648	            finally:
649	                handle.close()
650	            os.replace(tmp_name, path)
651	            self._fsync_directory(directory)
652	        except BaseException:
653	            # After a successful replace the temp name is already gone.
654	            try:
655	                os.unlink(tmp_name)
656	            except OSError:
657	                pass
658	            raise
659	
660	    @staticmethod
661	    def _fsync_directory(directory: str) -> None:
662	        try:
663	            dir_fd = os.open(directory, os.O_RDONLY)
664	        except OSError:
665	            return
666	        try:
667	            os.fsync(dir_fd)
668	        except OSError:
669	            pass
670	        finally:
671	            os.close(dir_fd)

673	    @classmethod
674	    def load_checkpoint(cls, path: str | os.PathLike[str]) -> FleetSimulator:
675	        """Load an independent simulator instance from *path*.
676	
677	        The returned simulator shares no mutable state with the file or any
678	        other loaded instance. Invalid checkpoint content raises
679	        :class:`ValueError` explaining the reason; read/permission failures
680	        propagate as :class:`OSError`.
681	        """
682	        try:
683	            with open(path, "r", encoding="utf-8") as handle:
684	                text = handle.read()
685	        except OSError:
686	            raise
687	        try:
688	            data = json.loads(text)
689	        except json.JSONDecodeError as exc:
690	            raise ValueError(f"checkpoint is not valid JSON: {exc.msg}") from exc
691	        return cls._from_checkpoint(data)
692	
693	    @classmethod
694	    def _from_checkpoint(cls, data: object) -> FleetSimulator:
695	        if not isinstance(data, dict):
696	            raise ValueError("checkpoint root must be a JSON object")
697	
698	        version = data.get("version")
699	        if not _is_int(version):
700	            raise ValueError("checkpoint field 'version' must be an integer")
701	        if version not in _SUPPORTED_VERSIONS:
702	            raise ValueError(
703	                f"unsupported checkpoint version {version}; supported versions: "
704	                f"{sorted(_SUPPORTED_VERSIONS)}"
705	            )
706	
707	        grid = cls._load_grid(data)
708	        tick = cls._load_tick(data)
709	        robot_records, task_records = cls._load_entities(data)
710	
711	        map_changes: list[dict[str, object]] = []
712	        paused: set[str] = set()
713	        if version == 1:
714	            replay = cls._load_legacy_replay(data)
715	            base_grid = grid
716	        else:
717	            replay = cls._load_replay(data)
718	            map_changes = cls._load_map_changes(data)
719	            paused = cls._load_paused_tasks(data)
720	            base_grid = cls._load_base_grid(data)
721	            if (base_grid.width, base_grid.height) != (grid.width, grid.height):
722	                raise ValueError("base grid dimensions must match the current grid")
723	            cls._validate_map_history(base_grid, grid, map_changes)
724	
725	        robots: list[Robot] = []
726	        for record in robot_records:
727	            position = _as_pair(record["position"], f"robot {record['robot_id']!r} position")
728	            if not grid.traversable(position):
729	                raise ValueError(
730	                    f"robot {record['robot_id']!r} position {list(position)} is outside "
731	                    "the map or inside an obstacle"
732	                )
733	            route: list[tuple[int, int]] = []
734	            previous = position
735	            for index, cell in enumerate(record["route"]):
736	                waypoint = _as_pair(
737	                    cell, f"robot {record['robot_id']!r} route entry {index}"
738	                )
739	                if not grid.traversable(waypoint):
740	                    raise ValueError(
741	                        f"robot {record['robot_id']!r} route entry {list(waypoint)} is "
742	                        "outside the map or inside an obstacle"
743	                    )
744	                if abs(waypoint[0] - previous[0]) + abs(waypoint[1] - previous[1]) != 1:
745	                    raise ValueError(
746	                        f"robot {record['robot_id']!r} route moves non-adjacently from "
747	                        f"{list(previous)} to {list(waypoint)}"
748	                    )
749	                route.append(waypoint)
750	                previous = waypoint
751	            distance = record["distance_travelled"]
752	            if not _is_int(distance) or distance < 0:
753	                raise ValueError(
754	                    f"robot {record['robot_id']!r} distance_travelled must be a "
755	                    "non-negative integer"
756	                )
757	            robots.append(Robot(record["robot_id"], position, route, record["task_id"], distance))
758	
759	        tasks: list[Task] = []
760	        for record in task_records:
761	            pickup = _as_pair(record["pickup"], f"task {record['task_id']!r} pickup")
762	            dropoff = _as_pair(record["dropoff"], f"task {record['task_id']!r} dropoff")
763	            tasks.append(
764	                Task(
765	                    record["task_id"],
766	                    pickup,
767	                    dropoff,
768	                    record["assigned_robot"],
769	                    record["picked_up"],
770	                    record["completed"],
771	                )
772	            )
773	
774	        robot_by_id = {robot.robot_id: robot for robot in robots}
775	        task_by_id = {task.task_id: task for task in tasks}
776	
777	        for robot in robots:
778	            if robot.task_id is not None:
779	                task = task_by_id.get(robot.task_id)
780	                if task is None:
781	                    raise ValueError(
782	                        f"robot {robot.robot_id!r} executes unknown task {robot.task_id!r}"
783	                    )
784	                if task.completed:
785	                    raise ValueError(
786	                        f"robot {robot.robot_id!r} executes task {task.task_id!r} that is "
787	                        "already completed"
788	                    )
789	                if task.assigned_robot != robot.robot_id:
790	                    raise ValueError(
791	                        f"robot {robot.robot_id!r} executes task {task.task_id!r} but the "
792	                        f"task is assigned to {task.assigned_robot!r}"
793	                    )
794	        for task in tasks:
795	            if task.completed and not task.picked_up:
796	                raise ValueError(f"task {task.task_id!r} is completed but never picked up")
797	            if task.picked_up and task.assigned_robot is None:
798	                raise ValueError(
799	                    f"task {task.task_id!r} is picked up but has no assigned robot"
800	                )
801	            # Completed tasks retain historical ownership; their robots are free
802	            # to take new work, so the mutual binding only holds while a task is
803	            # still in progress.
804	            if not task.completed and task.assigned_robot is not None:
805	                owner = robot_by_id.get(task.assigned_robot)
806	                if owner is None:
807	                    raise ValueError(
808	                        f"task {task.task_id!r} is assigned to unknown robot "
809	                        f"{task.assigned_robot!r}"
810	                    )
811	                if owner.task_id != task.task_id:
812	                    raise ValueError(
813	                        f"task {task.task_id!r} claims robot {owner.robot_id!r} but the "
814	                        f"robot executes {owner.task_id!r}"
815	                    )
816	
817	        cls._validate_paused_state(paused, task_by_id, robot_by_id, grid)
818	        traffic_waits = cls._load_traffic_waits(data, robot_by_id)
819	
820	        replay_change_frames = cls._replay_map_change_frames(replay)
821	        if replay_change_frames != map_changes:
822	            raise ValueError("replay map-change frames do not match 'map_changes' history")
823	
824	        simulator = cls(grid, robots, tasks)
825	        simulator.base_grid = base_grid
826	        simulator.tick = tick
827	        simulator.replay = copy.deepcopy(replay)
828	        simulator.map_changes = copy.deepcopy(map_changes)
829	        simulator._map_sequence = len(map_changes)
830	        simulator.paused_tasks = set(paused)
831	        simulator._traffic_waits = traffic_waits
832	        # Version 1 has no edit history: its saved grid is the baseline and
833	        # applies to every tick frame. Version 2 replays the recorded changes
834	        # alongside the frames so each frame is judged against its contemporary
835	        # map.
836	        cls._validate_replay_positions(replay, tick, robot_by_id, base_grid, map_changes)
837	        return simulator

843	        return data[field_name]

845	    @classmethod
846	    def _load_grid(cls, data: Mapping[str, object]) -> GridMap:
847	        raw = cls._require_field(data, "grid")
848	        if not isinstance(raw, dict):
849	            raise ValueError("checkpoint field 'grid' must be an object")
850	        width = raw.get("width")
851	        height = raw.get("height")
852	        if not _is_int(width) or width <= 0:
853	            raise ValueError("checkpoint grid width must be a positive integer")
854	        if not _is_int(height) or height <= 0:
855	            raise ValueError("checkpoint grid height must be a positive integer")
856	        raw_obstacles = raw.get("obstacles")
857	        if not isinstance(raw_obstacles, list):
858	            raise ValueError("checkpoint grid 'obstacles' must be a list")
859	        obstacles: set[tuple[int, int]] = set()
860	        for index, cell in enumerate(raw_obstacles):
861	            obstacle = _as_pair(cell, f"obstacle entry {index}")
862	            if not (0 <= obstacle[0] < width and 0 <= obstacle[1] < height):
863	                raise ValueError(f"obstacle {list(obstacle)} lies outside the map")
864	            obstacles.add(obstacle)
865	        try:
866	            return GridMap(width, height, frozenset(obstacles))
867	        except ValueError as exc:
868	            raise ValueError(f"invalid checkpoint grid: {exc}") from exc

902	    @classmethod
903	    def _load_entities(
904	        cls, data: Mapping[str, object]
905	    ) -> tuple[list[dict[str, object]], list[dict[str, object]]]:
906	        raw_robots = cls._require_field(data, "robots")
907	        raw_tasks = cls._require_field(data, "tasks")
908	        if not isinstance(raw_robots, list):
909	            raise ValueError("checkpoint field 'robots' must be a list")
910	        if not isinstance(raw_tasks, list):
911	            raise ValueError("checkpoint field 'tasks' must be a list")
912	
913	        robot_records: list[dict[str, object]] = []
914	        robot_ids: set[str] = set()
915	        for index, record in enumerate(raw_robots):
916	            if not isinstance(record, dict):
917	                raise ValueError(f"robot entry {index} must be an object")
918	            robot_id = record.get("robot_id")
919	            if not isinstance(robot_id, str):
920	                raise ValueError(f"robot entry {index} field 'robot_id' must be a string")
921	            if robot_id in robot_ids:
922	                raise ValueError(f"duplicate robot id {robot_id!r} in checkpoint")
923	            robot_ids.add(robot_id)
924	            task_id = record.get("task_id")
925	            if task_id is not None and not isinstance(task_id, str):
926	                raise ValueError(f"robot {robot_id!r} field 'task_id' must be a string or null")
927	            if "position" not in record:
928	                raise ValueError(f"robot {robot_id!r} is missing field 'position'")
929	            route = record.get("route")
930	            if not isinstance(route, list):
931	                raise ValueError(f"robot {robot_id!r} field 'route' must be a list")
932	            if "distance_travelled" not in record:
933	                raise ValueError(f"robot {robot_id!r} is missing field 'distance_travelled'")
934	            robot_records.append(record)
935	
936	        task_records: list[dict[str, object]] = []
937	        task_ids: set[str] = set()
938	        for index, record in enumerate(raw_tasks):
939	            if not isinstance(record, dict):
940	                raise ValueError(f"task entry {index} must be an object")
941	            task_id = record.get("task_id")
942	            if not isinstance(task_id, str):
943	                raise ValueError(f"task entry {index} field 'task_id' must be a string")
944	            if task_id in task_ids:
945	                raise ValueError(f"duplicate task id {task_id!r} in checkpoint")
946	            task_ids.add(task_id)
947	            assigned = record.get("assigned_robot")
948	            if assigned is not None and not isinstance(assigned, str):
949	                raise ValueError(
950	                    f"task {task_id!r} field 'assigned_robot' must be a string or null"
951	                )
952	            if not isinstance(record.get("picked_up"), bool):
953	                raise ValueError(f"task {task_id!r} field 'picked_up' must be a boolean")
954	            if not isinstance(record.get("completed"), bool):
955	                raise ValueError(f"task {task_id!r} field 'completed' must be a boolean")
956	            if "pickup" not in record:
957	                raise ValueError(f"task {task_id!r} is missing field 'pickup'")
958	            if "dropoff" not in record:
959	                raise ValueError(f"task {task_id!r} is missing field 'dropoff'")
960	            task_records.append(record)
961	
962	        positions = [
963	            tuple(record["position"])
964	            for record in robot_records
965	            if isinstance(record["position"], list)
966	            and len(record["position"]) == 2
967	            and all(_is_int(value) for value in record["position"])
968	        ]
969	        if len(positions) != len(set(positions)):
970	            raise ValueError("checkpoint robots cannot share a position")
971	        return robot_records, task_records

976	    ) -> list[tuple[int, int]]:

978	            raise ValueError(f"{context} field {field_name!r} must be a list")

985	    @classmethod
986	    def _load_map_changes(cls, data: Mapping[str, object]) -> list[dict[str, object]]:
987	        raw = cls._require_field(data, "map_changes")
988	        if not isinstance(raw, list):
989	            raise ValueError("checkpoint field 'map_changes' must be a list")
990	        changes: list[dict[str, object]] = []
991	        last_tick = -1
992	        last_sequence = 0
993	        for index, frame in enumerate(raw):
994	            context = f"map change {index}"
995	            if not isinstance(frame, dict):
996	                raise ValueError(f"{context} must be an object")
997	            tick = frame.get("tick")
998	            sequence = frame.get("sequence")
999	            if not _is_int(tick) or tick < 0:
1000	                raise ValueError(f"{context} field 'tick' must be a non-negative integer")
1001	            if not _is_int(sequence) or sequence <= 0:
1002	                raise ValueError(f"{context} field 'sequence' must be a positive integer")
1003	            if sequence != index + 1:
1004	                raise ValueError(
1005	                    f"map change sequences must run consecutively from 1; change {index} "
1006	                    f"has sequence {sequence}, expected {index + 1}"
1007	                )
1008	            if tick < last_tick:
